description: Read customers from Sage — READ ONLY. version selects which of the two connectors is used. Sage 100 returns kto (the account number, NOT the matchcode) plus name and delivery address; Sage Business Cloud returns reference, name, email and the nested main address. Paging differs per version and is handled inside; you get one flat list.

search.description: Name fragment (Sage 100: matched via where on matchcode).

version.description: Sage connector to read from: Sage 100 or Sage Business Cloud

name: list_sage_customers
